Areas We Supply Elevators in Bangalore
Q1. What types of elevators do you supply in Bangalore?
We supply passenger, home, hospital, goods, hydraulic, and MRL elevators.
Q2. How long does it take to supply and install an elevator?
Typically, installation takes 4–8 weeks, depending on the type and customization.
Q3. Do you offer warranties for your elevators?
Yes, all elevators supplied by BG Elevators come with manufacturer warranties and AMC options.
Q4. Can you supply elevators for ongoing projects?
Yes, we work with builders, architects, and contractors to supply elevators for new and ongoing projects.
